data.name: NoAttributeFlowsYetHint
data.value: Use the Add Attribute Flow button to say which attribute values this Synchronization Rule moves.

data.name: MissingInputIntro
data.value: What to do when an attribute this Expression reads has no value on the object being synchronized.

data.name: MissingInputFailObjectHint
data.value: Run no Attribute Flow on this Synchronization Rule for the object. For identity-critical output.

data.name: MissingInputFailObjectWarning
data.value: While this is set, an object missing any attribute this Expression reads will not synchronize at all: none of its attributes flow, and it is reported as an error on every run until the missing value is supplied.

data.name: StandardMappingsGuidance
data.value: Standard Mappings are guidance only; any attribute can be chosen, and they never affect what synchronization flows.

data.name: MoreThanOneRuleContributes
data.value: More than one Synchronization Rule contributes {0}. Its priority order decides which value wins.

data.name: NullIsValueHelp
data.value: When this Synchronization Rule applies to a Connected System Object that is joined to a Metaverse Object, but contributes no value, treat that as an authoritative "no value": clear the Metaverse Object attribute value rather than falling back to a lower-priority contributor. A rule that results in no opinion (rule disabled, Connected System Object not joined, or out of scope) is skipped regardless.

data.name: NullIsValueWarning
data.value: Wherever this Synchronization Rule wins priority, a blank in the Connected System now clears the Metaverse Object attribute value rather than leaving it alone. A truncated or empty import therefore clears the attribute across every object this rule covers.

data.name: EnabledHelp
data.value: A disabled Attribute Flow is skipped by synchronization until it is re-enabled. Where another Attribute Flow also contributes the attribute, its value takes over at the next synchronization; values only this flow contributed stay in place.

data.name: EnabledHelpShort
data.value: A disabled Attribute Flow is skipped by synchronization until it is re-enabled.

data.name: PasswordDeliveryNote
data.value: Password delivery leaves Enabled and Password never expires to this Attribute Flow. Initial Passwords and synchronized passwords do not change them.

data.name: DisabledMappingDescription
data.value: This Attribute Flow is disabled and skipped by synchronization until it is re-enabled.

data.name: UnavailableAlsoAlreadyTargeted
data.value: It also corresponds to {0}, which another Attribute Flow on this Synchronization Rule already targets.

data.name: UnavailableFirstAlreadyTargeted
data.value: In {0}, {1} corresponds to {2}, which another Attribute Flow on this Synchronization Rule already targets.

data.name: MvaToSvaWarningImport
data.value: {0} is Multi-Valued but {1} is Single-Valued. If a synchronized object has more than one value, no value will flow for this attribute and an error will be recorded against that object (a single value flows normally). To always flow a value, target a Multi-Valued attribute or use an Expression to select one.
